node.statement: For every finite exact signed idempotent P, every pair of row indices (r,s), and every point c of the row polytope K(P), the full row-point fibers Q with ||p_Q - c||_1 > 1/2 jointly carry positive coefficient mass P_r^+ + P_s^+ at least ||p_r - p_s||_1/(2*(2 + 4*delta(P))) - 2*delta(P).
